{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates on patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().any())

# Check the distribution of `arm`
print("\nDistribution of `arm`:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of `severity`
print("\nDistribution of `severity`:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in `biomarker_baseline`
print("\nSentinel values in `biomarker_baseline`:")
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Check if `biomarker_baseline` has negative values
print("\nNegative values in `biomarker_baseline`:")
print(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] < 0]['biomarker_baseline'].count())

# Check the distribution of `biomarker_final` by arm
print("\nMean biomarker_final by arm:")
print(df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_final'].mean())

# Check the distribution of `biomarker_final` by severity
print("\nMean biomarker_final by severity:")
print(df.groupby('severity')['biomarker_final'].mean())

# Check for baseline biomarker differences by arm
print("\nMean biomarker_baseline by arm:")
print(df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Check for baseline biomarker differences by severity
print("\nMean biomarker_baseline by severity:")
print(df.groupby('severity')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())"}
